# Waymark JS

> Waymark JS is a headless GeoJSON runtime for MapLibre GL JS. The consumer creates and owns the map and its UI; Waymark mounts GeoJSON overlays, applies type-based paint and icon name hooks, emits DOM CustomEvents, and round-trips a serialisable instance document.

## API

- [API reference](1.api.md): `createInstance({ map, document? })`, config/paint/types, the returned instance shape, events, and serialisation.
- [Data contract](6.data.md): GeoJSON layer input, validation, mounting, and runtime additions.
- [Map boundary](4.map.md): what Waymark does and does not do with the consumer's map.

## Optional

- [Instances](3.instances.md): internal orchestration boundaries and baseline-vs-delta serialisation semantics.
- [Development](2.development.md): contributor workflow, testing strategy, and doc sync protocol.
- [Documentation index](README.md): full docs reading order and scope.
